findings.summary: Standardization uses mean/std from the whole DataFrame, and build_features runs before the train/test split, so test data leaks into training scaling and inflates test AUC; the statistics are also not saved, so inference on a single row gives NaN and batches are scaled differently from training.
A zero-variance column has zero standard deviation, so the division yields NaN or inf and LogisticRegression.fit raises a ValueError.
